anti_goal_violations.anti_goal: The historical atlas is exploratory forever. No historical observation is ever served, labeled, or counted as forward confirmation; discovery data renders only under its exploratory label. (critical)
anti_goal_violations.evidence: docs/handoffs/goal-referee-iter-6-audit.md finding B1 — apps/backend/app/research/referee_routes.py exposed `registered_at: Optional[str]` on the registration body and forwarded it into register_hypothesis, where apps/backend/app/research/referee_registry.py:665 makes it the sole input to the boundary derivation; the CLI carried the same `--registered-at` knob. Proven live pre-fix: a POST with registered_at 2025-01-01 stored confirmation_start_boundary 2024-12-31 and made three pre-existing historical sessions accrue as post-boundary confirmation, in an append-only record with no delete path.
anti_goal_violations.resolution: Fixed inside iteration 6 by the full pipeline's hard-audit lane and re-verified live by the evaluator there (a caller-supplied 2025-01-01 instant is ignored; today's honest ET date is stored). RE-CONFIRMED STILL CLOSED IN ITERATION 7: the iter-7 diff touches referee_registry.py only for Rider 2 (integrity_errors disclosure) and Rider 3 (dead-import removal) — no boundary-derivation code changed, and iteration 7 independently re-verifies the same rail from the other side (TC-8: an on-boundary and a deep-backfilled record both contribute zero to coverage and to T). RE-CONFIRMED STILL CLOSED IN ITERATION 8 from a third side: the new /desk registration UI cannot reach the boundary seam (its POST body carries no registered_at field at all), and the evaluator's own isolated probe registered through the same path and got a server-stamped 2026-08-15 boundary.

anti_goal_violations.anti_goal: The historical atlas is exploratory forever. No historical observation is ever served, labeled, or counted as forward confirmation; discovery data renders only under its exploratory label. (critical)
anti_goal_violations.evidence: docs/handoffs/goal-referee-iter-8-audit.md finding B2 — referee_registry.shortlist_response served `projected_days_to_target = max(0.0, (target_sessions - n_sessions) / accrual_rate)`, subtracting a candidate's PRE-boundary historical sessions from a target that is a post-boundary count everywhere else it is used. Against the operator's real corpus every estimand-A candidate rendered '0 days — ready now' for honest waits of 74 / 119 / 50 days.
anti_goal_violations.resolution: Found and fixed INSIDE this same iteration by the hard-audit lane (`projected_days_to_target = target_sessions / accrual_rate`, measured from zero; the divide-by-zero guard unchanged) with its own replacement test, and independently reproduced by the evaluator on an isolated fixture corpus (pre-fix 517 vs post-fix 564 on the browser rig's own 47-day / 1-session corpus). Scored MINOR rather than critical because the value is a pure read-side projection with zero persisted output, no record ever counted it toward confirmation, and it never reached the operator's real screen — the only capture of it is the QA rig screenshot, which is why J-07 carries evidence_makeup.
